answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. What this achieves is a system where the cost of an attack is public and provable, so the whole network can trust verdicts without trusting any single identity.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a beacon as the anchor of the cost.
